about: Affiliate ids for node/commission.mjs. Empty = off: nothing changes. Ids are public (they stand in every link they make): fill them by pull request. MARE_COMMISSION in the node's environment wins over this file.
A commission never changes an order or a verdict, and every such link says so (commission: true, a marker, the rule).

Amazon (domains, e.g. "amazon.de": {"tag": "yourtag-21"}): always handed out as a direct, visible link with Amazon's sentence beside it, never through /via/. PartnerNet pays nothing after an automatic redirect through a page in between (Verguetungskatalog Ziff. 2(e)); its agent terms apply since 14.04.2026.
Awin first (awin.affid and awin.merchants {"shop.example": "awinmid"}): name only shops that accepted an agent directory.
Skimlinks or Sovrn (wrap.network, wrap.id or wrap.key): only with "agentsAllowed": true, once the network allowed agent traffic in writing; they exclude bot traffic.
Any part may say "direct": true: its links are handed out directly and never ride a /via/ redirect.
